meta.title: Lunayla | R&B and Latin rhythms artist, Montréal
meta.description: Official website of Lunayla, an independent Montréal artist with Cuban roots. Contemporary R&B meets Latin rhythms: listen to ESA NOCHE, explore her journey and get in touch.

hero.photoAlt: Lunayla sits in front of a purple door, wearing a magenta scarf top, looking at the camera.

about.title: About
paragraphs: Lunayla is an independent artist from Montréal with Cuban roots. She blends contemporary R&B with Latin rhythms into a vibrant, sensual sound grounded in her heritage and carried by a colourful, luminous universe.
A singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist, she makes every song an extension of herself.

With "ESA NOCHE",  modern salsa, she returns to the rhythms that shaped her musical identity. Feminine energy, confidence, the freedom to move from one world, one language and one sound to another: all of it, por el amor del arte.
about.photoAlt: Lunayla sings with her eyes closed, mic in hand, in warm light.
